name: Jinrou Kitan ~Soshite Bokura wa Aoi Yoru no Uta o Kiku~
original_name: 人狼奇譚 ～そしてぼくらは蒼い夜のうたをきく～
source:
A mediocre high school student is once killed by a werewolf and then revived as the same kind. He finds his killer who is a girl during daytime and a beast at night. She says that there is nothing to fear as they can together venture in the night now...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名平凡的高中生被狼人杀死，随后却以同类的身份复活。他找到了杀害自己的凶手——白天是少女，夜晚则化身野兽。她说，没什么好害怕的，因为从今往后，两人可以一起在夜里冒险了……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
